rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for doing physical exercise.

example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 wan6 dung6

rows.note: Use 運動 as the all-purpose noun for activity aimed at physical fitness, rather than skill practice.

example.english: I get some exercise every day to stay healthy.
example.traditional: 我每日做運動，保持身體健康。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 zou6 wan6 dung6 bou2 ci4 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1

rows.note: Use 腦力訓練 specifically for mental exercise intended to keep the brain active or improve mental ability.

example.english: I do mental exercise every day to keep my brain alert.
example.traditional: 我每日做腦力訓練，保持個腦清醒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 zou6 nou5 lik6 fan3 lin6 bou2 ci4 go3 nou5 cing1 sing2

rows.note: Use 練習 for a task or activity designed to develop a skill, such as a writing exercise.

example.english: This is a writing exercise that can improve your writing.
example.traditional: 呢個係寫作練習，可以幫你改善文筆。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 se2 zok3 lin6 zaap6 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 goi2 sin6 man4 bat1

rows.note: Use this for practising or training a skill, person, animal, or mental ability.

example.english: They exercise their Cantonese every day.
example.traditional: 佢哋每日都練習廣東話。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 mui5 jat6 dou1 lin6 zaap6 gwong2 dung1 waa2

rows.note: Use this mainly for exercising a right, option, power, or authority, especially in formal contexts.

example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 haang4 si2 ni1 go3 kyun4 lei6
